sections.text:
Power 
 Station

Technical 
 Procedure
Equipment:
Generator
Triphase T237 - 370
Introduction

This document outlines the 
major maintenance procedures P1, to be carried out every five years as indicated by Y5 in the titled block

The generator of the steam 
turbine as any generator is used for generating the electricity. The generator 
type is brushless (self induced).
Technical Specifications

The first draft is initiated by 
eng. Mohamed Abdel Azeem, tested by eng. Esam Darwish, reviewed by eng. Ahmed 
Fathy, revised by inspection and quality control at EDEPC eng Abouda Elbanna, 
approved by general manager eng. Mohamed Anan and accepted by head sector 
president eng. Mohamed Elsarrag .

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil; 
 EDEPC inspection & quality control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman: 
 EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general director, and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety Precaution

items:
A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs etc.

Be sure that the turbine is 
 out of service and turning gear is off.

Be sure that the all 
 electrical & instrumentation cables are completely isolated.

Be sure that the fire fighting 
 system is isolated.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Complete maintenance tool set.
Set of wires.
Cleaning articles.

Fillers, Vibrometers, dial 
 gauges and slip gauges.

Special tools for clamping and 
 extracting the generator rotor and the exciter.

Hydraulic pump for unbolting 
 the LP / Gen coupling.

sections.text: Work to be Carried out

Before disassembly, you must 
 record all clearances and measurements of the unit during normal 
 operation.
Disassembly

items:
Remove the journal bearing 
 strap.
Dismantle the thermocouple.

Remove the upper half journal 
 bearing.

Sling the lower part of the 
 bearing by using two eyebolts in the distinct position.

Lift the lower part of the 
 bearing.

sections.text: Inspection
Cleaning

items:
Degrease bearing blocks with 
 non corrosive product and rags.

Clean carefully the GEN inside 
 area with adequate products and solvents.

Clean the four coolers by 
 chemical agents.
Clean all the bolts.

sections.text: Checking the Bearing Blocks

items:
Check the journal bearings 
 clearances.

Check the sliding planes 
 condition.

Check the journal bearings 
 surface condition.

Check the journal bearings 
 mating - faces.

sections.text: Assembly

items:
Pull down the lower part of 
 the bearing in its grooved place.

Tight the screws fixing the 
 lower part with the pedestal.

Put the bearing upper casing 
 on the lower half.

Tight the screws that assemble 
 the two halves of the casing.
